breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Tab bar below, side navigation from here up.

components.name: Glass panel
components.description: The one container: balance, entries, notifications. Never nested.
components.css: .ds-glass { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); border-radius: 22.4px; padding: 20px; color: #f5f5f7; backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(140%); } .ds-glass-label { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: rgb(245 245 247 / 0.64); } .ds-glass-value { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Side navigation link
components.description: Desktop destination; the active one is marked by glass and a full hairline border.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 18.2px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: rgb(245 245 247 / 0.64); font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); color: #f5f5f7; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b18cff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-on { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); color: #f5f5f7; }

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The one primary action of a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 46px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #f5f5f7; color: #000; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b18cff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Account card
components.description: Signature piece: tilted floating card with a periodic light sweep; finish by account type.
components.html: Black•••• 4821
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; width: 288px; aspect-ratio: 1.586; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2c2c31, #0b0b0e); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7); transform: perspective(900px) rotateX(10deg) rotateY(-10deg); } .ds-card-type { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-chip { position: absolute; top: 60px; left: 20px; width: 37px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f4e2a6, #b8954a); } .ds-card-num { position: absolute; left: 20px; bottom: 18px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; opacity: 0.86; }

narrative.overview: Pure black field lit by slow diffuse lights, content floating on frosted glass, and the floating account card as the one authored moment. Chosen by the user among six mockups (stage 11 spec).
keyCharacteristics: Floating 3D account card with light sweep

rules.name: A Regra da Luz
rules.body: Color only enters as light, never as a flat fill.

rules.name: A Regra do Vidro Único
rules.body: Glass is never nested in glass.

dos: Let the card be the one authored moment of a screen
Mark states by shape, not by color alone
Keep loops on transform/opacity and stop them under reduced motion
donts: Colored side bar on an active item
